jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
jobs.description:
Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform
  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level

What you'll do
  
  
We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.
  
  
**Additionally, You’ll Be**

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.
  
  
You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.
  
  
**You’ll Also Have**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.**
We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!
  
  
As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.
  
  
We’re a world-class, well-funded, diverse team from over 20 different countries that believes in the product we’re building and the service we’re providing for our members. We’ve grown significantly in the last 18 months and are evolving our Marketing structure to reflect that.
  
  
**We are offering a salary of up to 2,500,000 INR for this role, plus a company cash bonus scheme and benefits**
**About The Role**
We're hiring a senior product designer who puts members first and uses AI to move faster. You'll understand our members deeply, design journeys that genuinely help them, and use Claude Design to turn ideas into tested, build-ready designs in days rather than weeks.
  
  
You'll be based in India and work closely with product managers, the rest of the design team and compliance across the UK and India. Half your value is what you design and ship for members. The other half is helping the team work in an AI-first way.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the design of the member experience across their whole time with us, from sign-up to the day they leave. Work with your PM from framing the problem to a design the team can build.
* Start with members. Run regular remote research and usability tests with our UK members, listen to member calls and read feedback, and bring what you learn into every decision.
* Design for members who may be financially stretched or vulnerable, so journeys are clear, fair and easy to use. Help us deliver good outcomes under the UK's Consumer Duty.
* Design in Claude Design and produce build-ready work: clear flows, states, edge cases and specs that need few handoffs.
* Use AI to prototype and test ideas with real members quickly, and to run more experiments on our most important journeys.
* Help move the team from Figma-first to Claude Design-first, with a bias for action.
* Grow our design system, so components stay consistent and reusable.
* Raise the bar on quality: accessibility, responsive behaviour, content and the small details members notice.
* Work with compliance early so regulated copy and flows are right first time.
* Share what you learn. Pair with designers, run show and tells, and write things down.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* Five or more years in product design, with a portfolio that shows how you think and the difference your work made for customers.
* A track record of putting customers first: you've used research, data and testing to understand real needs, and changed a design because of what you learned.
* Hands-on experience designing with AI tools (ideally Claude Design), with good judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* A strong grasp of accessibility and inclusive design,

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer- AI
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer – AI**
who is passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered product experiences that simplify complex problems and create meaningful customer impact.

You will work at the intersection of Product Design, AI and emerging technologies, designing intuitive experiences that make AI capabilities accessible, useful and trustworthy for customers.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, senior leadership and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance customer experiences, rethink existing workflows and build innovative solutions.

We are looking for a designer who combines strong UI/UX fundamentals with curiosity about AI, understands how users interact with intelligent systems and can translate complex AI capabilities into simple, human-centric experiences.

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end experiences for AI-powered products and features, from problem discovery and user journeys to high-fidelity UI and interaction design.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to solve customer problems, simplify workflows and improve product experiences.
* Design intuitive conversational interfaces, AI assistants, chat-based experiences and intelligent user interactions.
* Translate complex AI capabilities, outputs and workflows into simple, understandable and user-friendly experiences.
* Design for AI-specific interactions, including prompts, responses, recommendations, contextual suggestions, feedback loops and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Explore and prototype AI-powered product concepts rapidly, using emerging AI tools and technologies.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists to understand AI capabilities, technical constraints and opportunities for product innovation.
* Design experiences that build user trust through transparency, explainability, appropriate feedback and clear communication of AI-generated outputs.
* Anticipate AI-specific user experience challenges such as inaccurate responses, uncertainty, latency and unexpected outputs, and design appropriate user experiences around them.
* Conduct user research and usability testing to understand how customers interact with AI-powered features and continuously improve the experience.
* Contribute to Jupiter's design system and ensure consistency across AI-powered and traditional product experiences.
* Use qualitative insights and product metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of AI experiences and drive continuous improvements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years of hands-on Product Design experience in consumer-facing technology or product-led organisations.
* Experience designing AI-powered products, intelligent interfaces, conversational experiences or AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLM-powered applications, generative AI and conversational user experiences.
* A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design capabilities, preferably including AI-driven product experiences.
* Excellent UI/UX, interaction design, prototyping and visual design skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and translate them into intuitive customer experiences.
* Understanding of prompt-based interactions, contextual responses, AI recommendations and human-AI collaboration.
* Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business objectives and technical feasibility.
* Comfortable

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 400 million registered users. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. In 2017, PhonePe forayed into financial services with the launch of digital gold, providing users with a safe and convenient option to buy 24-karat gold securely on its platform. PhonePe has since launched Mutual Funds and Insurance products like tax-saving funds, liquid funds, international travel insurance, Corona Care, a dedicated insurance product for the COVID-19 pandemic among others.
  
  
At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**As a Product Lead, you will:**

* Own and articulate unique problem statements across multiple technology stacks and come up with platform component design for the problem domain.
* Take over revenue and cost considerations over and above customer lifecycle metrics for a single product along with managing multiple product lines.
* Create product strategy from the ground up for an assigned problem area
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.
* Own resource planning for your pod and participate in planning for other pods.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 8+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own high-impact product areas from strategy → 0→1 → scale. You’ll work closely with the Founder, Product, Engineering, Design and business leadership to identify the biggest customer problems, define the product vision, make high-conviction bets and drive them through execution.

This is a role for someone who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps.

* Be relentlessly close to the customer - Talk to users, understand their financial behaviour and uncover unmet needs. Combine qualitative insights with data to make better product decisions. Build products that are simple enough for the next 10 million users.

**What we’re looking for**

* Exceptional academic and professional track record; IIT/NIT or equivalent undergraduate degree and/or top-tier MBA.
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building consumer products at scale with experience owning products end-to-end, including 0→1 launches.

* A positive attitude willingness to learn desire to improve the environment around you

* Track record as an engineer working in a globally distributed team
  
* On-the-job examples of working in a fast-paced Agile environment
  
* Our Stack
  
* CI/CD: GitLab

Nice to have

* Motivated to go the extra mile

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

More about
**our mission**
and

.

You’ll help us build the next generation of systems that help us run multi region, scalable processes to identify customers who they say they are and ensure any processes minimise the chance of financial crime manifesting throughout a customers lifecycle. + This is a team about building sustainable, long term foundations

* Stakeholder partnership

+ Shape the ‘what next’ for product outcomes

This is a Senior Analyst role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. The Banking Operations Associate performs non-customer-facing back office processing across two connected domains: Deposit Operations (checking/savings account servicing, ACH and money movement, account closures, disputes intake, card operations support) and Lending Operations (loan/credit product servicing support, payment application, delinquency and collections-adjacent processing, and credit-related account maintenance). This is a Tier Tier 2 / Backoffice agent that executes defined procedures against source systems, apply documented decision rules, and escalate exceptions. The role sits within a regulated banking environment and requires strict adherence to bank-partner procedures, NACHA operating rules, and consumer protection regulations (principally Regulation E, Regulation Z, FCRA and FDCPA).

**2. Core Responsibilities Deposit Operations**

**Account Servicing & Closures**

* Process routine account closures across defined closure types (voluntary, involuntary, dormant/inactive, fraud-related, death/estate) following the documented decision tree and non-post rules.
* Execute account maintenance requests: address/contact updates, hold placements and releases, beneficiary updates, and account status changes within system-of-record
* Money Operations daily oversight and daily tasks

**ACH & Money Movement**

* Process ACH exception items (non-post exceptions, returns, NOCs) according to NACHA return code guidance and internal SLA timers; escalate volume spikes above the automation trigger threshold.
* Support 5-Days-Early (5DE) routing exceptions and inbound/outbound file reconciliation tasks.
* Perform first-line review of Positive Pay exception queues and flag suspected file-formatting anomalies (e.g., check-number leading-digit mismatches) rather than auto-rejecting items.
* Non post payments exceptions.
* Reconciliations.

**Card Management**

* Process card reissue and hotlist requests per fraud/disputes agent instructions; confirm Account Updater eligibility for recurring-biller cards prior to reissue.
* Support plastic card lifecycle tasks: activation exceptions, PIN reset processing, and card control object review (read-only queue triage).

**Regulatory Complaints Intake**

* Log incoming CFPB/FDIC/state regulator complaints into the complaints management system with accurate categorization; route to the appropriate bank-partner workflow (case-by-case or monthly-reporting model depending on partner).
* Track SLA clocks and flag cases approaching aging thresholds for supervisory attention.

**3. Core Responsibilities Lending Operations**

**Loan & Credit Product Servicing**

* Process routine servicing transactions for lending-adjacent products (e.g., Credit Builder, secured lines) — payment application & research, account status updates, and payoff/closure requests.
* Support Early Unlock and early-cancellation request intake, applying documented eligibility rules and escalating ambiguous cases.
* Conduct account level research and operational analysis to support dispute resolution and customer remediation activities

**Delinquency & Collections-Adjacent Support**

* Perform back-office queue management for past-due accounts: assist with operational activities related to payment arrangements, hardship programs, generate standard correspondence, and update account notes per the collections workflow — no direct collections calling unless explicitly scoped and licens

Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fin

jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts

**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

jobs.title: Client Services & Banking Executive
jobs.description:
Bayut & dubizzle have the unique distinction of being iconic, homegrown brands with a strong presence across the seven emirates in the UAE. Connecting millions of users across the country, we are committed to delivering the best online search experience.

  

As part of Dubizzle Group, we are alongside some of the strongest classified brands in the market. With a collective strength of 5 brands, we have more than 123 million monthly users that trust in our dedication to providing them with the best platform for their needs.  
As a Client Services and Banking Executive, you will manage end-to-end documentation processes, ensuring timely collection, compliance, and submission to financial institutions. You will facilitate seamless communication between the Sales department, banking partners and clients, providing regular updates and addressing inquiries. Additionally, you will maintain accurate records within the CRM system and support process optimisation initiatives.  
**In this role, you will:  
Client Communication & Documentation Management**

  

* Maintain proactive communication with banks and gather all required documents on time.
* Guide stakeholders through the application process, clarify requirements, and ensure a smooth documentation experience.
* Review and validate all submitted documents for completeness, accuracy, and authenticity.

**Application Preparation & Submission**

  

* Compile and organise application documents as per the bank’s specifications.
* Submit finalised applications to the appropriate financial institutions and maintain a record.

**Client Updates & Status Tracking**

  

* Provide clients with timely and transparent updates throughout the entire application lifecycle.
* Communicate outcomes, including approvals, rejections, and any additional documentation requests from financial institutions.
* Address client inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact between the Sales department, internal evaluation team, banking partners and the client.
* Facilitate smooth information flow and ensure alignment among all stakeholders involved in the application process.
* Coordinate meetings or discussions when necessary to resolve bottlenecks or address complex cases.

**Collaboration & Workflow Support**

  

* Assist in refining and improving operational workflows for better efficiency and turnaround times.
* Support the integration and onboarding of new banking partners into existing processes and systems.

* Record Keeping & CRM Management

* Maintain detailed, accurate, and up-to-date records of client interactions, documentation, and submission statuses.
* Perform routine bookkeeping tasks related to applications and transactions.
* Ensure all data is correctly entered and managed within the company’s CRM system for transparency and traceability.

Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.

**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs)

jobs.description:
**Role Description:**

  
  

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  
  

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

  
  

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

  
  

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

  
  

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

  
  

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

  
  

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

  
  

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

  
  

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

  
  

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

  
  

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

  
  

* 3-6 years of relevant experience
* Experience in banking operations, preferably in KYC/AML profile reviews.

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

 Hands-On Prototyping: Turn research findings into high-fidelity information architecture, interaction models, and realistic interactive prototypes (including edge cases and complex states) using Figma or equivalent tools.  
 Iterative Validation: Conduct multi-iteration testing with representative risk professionals to validate concepts, refine workflows, and document rationale for implementation.  
 Product Alignment & Challenge: Serve as an autonomous thought partner across product, engineering, and domain experts; challenge existing assumptions and propose improved structures based strictly on evidence.  
 Cross-Functional Handoff: Partner directly with Product Managers and engineers through the build phase, ensuring findings and decisions are thoroughly documented for seamless technical execution.

**Title:**
Client Solutions Partner, Applied AI

**Experience:**
7–15 years

**Location:**
Mumbai / Bangalore

Be the single point of contact for Quantiphi's Applied AI offering across an assigned portfolio of accounts. You turn each client's business challenges into defined, sellable Applied AI solutions and prove they can be built. You grow offering-attached bookings in those accounts by leading a team of Sales Engineers from discovery through technical sign-off.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Whitespace discovery and problem definition**

* Map Applied AI whitespace across each account's technology and business landscape with the Client Partner and Direct Sales, converting gaps into qualified offering-attached pipeline.
* Lead solution advisory workshops with customers, positioning Applied AI offerings before formal RFPs are issued.
* Convert business priorities into clearly defined technical problems with agreed scope, success criteria and constraints, so technology and business sponsors share one definition of the problem.
* Frame a roadmap for each account, from initial AI workloads (Agent Platform, GenAI, Agentic AI, ML/predictive, computer vision) to enterprise-wide adoption.

**Solution blueprinting and pursuits**

* Own the solution blueprint for Applied AI pursuits in the portfolio, covering: Reference architecture, Stack trade-offs, Technical risk assessment, A business case quantifying return, operational impact and risk.
* Direct technical RFP responses: solution narrative, architecture and data-pipeline design, effort estimates and BOM.
* Lead pitches tailored to each audience to secure technical sign-off: feasibility for technical evaluators, outcomes and ROI for business sponsors.

**PoCs and demonstrations**

* Define scope, success criteria and milestones for pre-sales PoCs and pilots where evidence strengthens the case.
* Present PoC results (accuracy, latency, business outcomes) to executive buyers, and convert successful PoCs into production SOWs.

**Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and allocate the Sales Engineers across portfolio pursuits.
* Review all blueprints, demos and RFP content before they reach the client.
* Run the weekly workload pipeline and pursuit review for the portfolio.

**Required Skills:**

* 7–15 years in technology services or enterprise software, including significant time in a senior customer-facing solutioning role.
* Hands-on depth in GenAI (RAG, agents, LLMs) plus ML/predictive or computer vision.
* Production-grade cloud architecture experience for AI systems.
* Ability to build business cases and ROI models that business sponsors and finance stakeholders accept.
* A record of winning technical evaluations and RFPs in enterprise deals.
* Credibility with both engineers and CXOs, explaining complex architectures in plain business terms.
* Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team.

**Preferred**

* Strong Cloud or Frontier Lab experience
* Professional cloud or AI certifications.
* Domain exposure in Manufacturing, Automotive, Transportation, or Logistics industries
* Practical grounding in responsible AI, AI evaluation and LLMOps/MLOps.

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.

jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Data\Information Management Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterpr

jobs.title: Sr Domain Sales Engineer - Tech & Business Transformation
jobs.description:
**This role is for a former strategy consultant who wants to stay in front of C-suite problems and see their thinking built, not just recommended.**
You will be the business lead for our team of Domain Sales Engineers (DSEs) in India. You define the client’s problem and the value at stake, decide what is worth building, and coach a team of early-career engineers to turn that into demos and proofs of concept that win executive decisions.

**Why this role exists**

Our DSEs build hands-on demos and proofs of concept (POCs) for enterprise clients, each within an industry or domain. They are capable builders and early in their careers. Where they need help is upstream of the build: understanding how the client’s business makes money, which problem is worth solving, how to size the value, and what story the demo has to tell a CFO or COO. A technically impressive demo that answers the wrong business question does not move a deal.

You will close that gap. You will work directly with our Account CTOs and Industry CTOs, who own the client relationships and technology direction, and you will make sure every demo and POC starts from a sharp business problem and ends with a value case the client can act on.

**What you will do**

**1. Frame the client’s problem and the value at stake**

* Work with Account and Industry CTOs ahead of client engagements to define the business problem, the decision-makers involved and what a good outcome looks like for the client.
* Lead executive discovery sessions and workshops with CXOs and business unit heads, using structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving.
* Build value driver trees and size the value at stake (revenue, cost, working capital, risk, customer experience) from client data, benchmarks and industry economics.
* Turn the value hypothesis into a business case with ROI, TCO and KPIs that a client CFO will accept.

**2. Decide what gets built, and make sure it lands**

* Translate the value case into a demo or POC scope: which use case, which process step, what data, and what result would prove the point.
* Write the executive storyline before the build starts, so the team knows what the demo has to show and why it matters to the audience.
* Review demos and POCs for business realism: the process reflects how the industry actually works, the KPIs are the right ones, and the numbers hold up under questioning.
* Present alongside the CTOs in executive briefings and steer the conversation toward a clear decision and next step.
* Shape proposals and RFP/RFI responses: problem statement, value case, roadmap and commercial logic.

**3. Lead and coach the DSE team the way you would run a case team**

* Act as engagement manager for the DSEs on each opportunity: frame the problem, split the work, review output and raise the bar.
* Teach the skills that separate a good builder from a trusted advisor: structured problem solving, industry economics, business case thinking, executive communication and storyline writing.
* Run regular problem-solving sessions and work reviews, and give direct, specific feedback.
* Build reusable assets the team can draw on: industry value driver trees, use case libraries with sized benefits, KPI benchmarks, discovery guides and storyline templates.
* Contribute to hiring and developing DSEs as the team grows.

**4. Build our industry point of view**

* Develop points of view on where AI changes the economics of specific industries and functions, and test them with clients.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

  
  
  
  
  

**The Team**

  
  
  

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

  
  
  

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo’s Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

  
  
  

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.
